title: openai.error.RateLimitError: Rate limit reached for 10KTPM-200RPM in organization org-mSnj0BKpxchO5RMRJ0Q7zro0 on tokens per min. Limit: 10000 / min. Please try again in 6ms.
body: need to insert a pause so we do not get this error

linked_prs.title: Fixed MetaGPT crashing due to openai.error.RateLimitError
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/metagpt/actions/action.py b/metagpt/actions/action.py
index 790295d551..6bdcc027de 100644
--- a/metagpt/actions/action.py
+++ b/metagpt/actions/action.py
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
 from abc import ABC
 from typing import Optional
 
-from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_fixed
+from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_random_exponential
 
 from metagpt.actions.action_output import ActionOutput
 from metagpt.llm import LLM
@@ -49,7 +49,7 @@ async def _aask(self, prompt: str, system_msgs: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> s
         system_msgs.append(self.prefix)
         return await self.llm.aask(prompt, system_msgs)
 
-    @retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_fixed(1))
+    @retry(wait=wait_random_exponential(min=1, max=60), stop=stop_after_attempt(6))
     async def _aask_v1(
         self,
         prompt: str,
